passives.name: Intruder from the Future
passives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Fighting Zone the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle. (A Fighting Zone powers up Fighting-type attacks.) Extends the duration of the Fighting Zone when the zone turns into a Fighting Zone while the user is on the field. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 ranks the first time it enters a battle each battle.

subPassives.name: Brawling Opening Sync
subPassives.description: Turns the field of play’s zone into a Fighting Zone the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle. (A Fighting Zone powers up Fighting-type attacks.)

subPassives.name: Fighting Zone Extension 3
subPassives.description: Extends the duration of the Fighting Zone when the zone turns into a Fighting Zone while the user is on the field.

subPassives.name: Strong Start 2
subPassives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 2 rank(s) the first time the user enters a battle each battle.

passives.name: Blades of the Future
passives.description: Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks when it uses Booster Energy or an ally turns the field of play’s terrain into Electric Terrain.

passives.name: Unbreakable Elite Mentality
passives.description: The user’s stats cannot be lowered. When an attack move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets itself or an ally is successful, that attack’s target becomes all allied sync pairs. When an attack move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets an opponent is successful, that attack’s target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power and chance of applying additional effects of moves affected by this passive skill are not lowered even if there are multiple targets. Increases the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank when its attack move hits.

subPassives.name: Impervious
subPassives.description: The user’s stats cannot be lowered.

subPassives.name: Extend Range
subPassives.description: When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets itself or an ally is successful, the target becomes all allied sync pairs. When a move used by the user’s Pokémon that targets an opponent is successful, the target becomes all opposing sync pairs. The power and chance of applying additional effects of moves affected by this passive skill are not lowered even if there are multiple targets.

subPassives.name: Strike: Physical Boost ↑1 & Special Boost ↑1 9
subPassives.description: Has a chance (100%) of increasing the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank when its attack move hits. If the move has the Multistrike effect tag, has a chance (100%) of increasing the user’s Physical Moves ↑ Next effect and Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 1 rank for each hit.

passives.name: Carve My Name into History
passives.description: Reduces the user’s sync move countdown by 3 the first time its Physical Moves ↑ Next effect is rank 6 or higher each battle. Increases the user’s Special Moves ↑ Next effect by 3 ranks the first time its Special Moves ↑ Next effect is rank 6 or higher each battle.

subPassives.name: 1st Physical Boost ≧ 6: Sync CD ↓ 3

subPassives.name: 1st Special Boost ≧ 6: Special Boost 3
